analysis.title: The 720: Alibaba, PDD & NetEase, Asics, Ryohin Keikaku, China Shipping & Shipbuilding, Eastroc, Japan Healthcare, Lenovo
key_insights: Alibaba 2QFY27 adjusted group EBITA came in 6% above GSe on stable traditional domestic e-commerce profits and narrowing quick commerce losses. GS cuts its 12m TPs to US$160/HK$156 from US$177/HK$172 and keeps Buy.

Alibaba cut CY27 Cloud revenue growth guidance to 30-45% from over 50% because of overseas compute constraints. Growth is guided back above 50% in CY28 as in-house T-Head capacity ramps. GS lowers its March 2028 quarter cloud revenue growth estimate to 32% from 57%.

GS expects Alibaba FCF to turn positive by 2H28, with peak AI infrastructure spending concentrated in CY27 and CY28. FY27E-FY29E adjusted EPS estimates move by -10% to +7%, driven by lower cloud profits. FY27E CMR growth is cut to -8% from -5% on soft consumption.

PDD 3Q26 adjusted operating profit of Rmb32.6bn was 51% above GSe, helped by faster online marketing services growth and sales and marketing discipline. Online marketing services revenue grew 12% YoY against GS's 10% estimate.

PDD transaction services revenue fell 12% YoY against GS's +6% estimate as Temu adjusts to EU customs changes and moves to local fulfillment. GS cuts FY26E-FY28E revenue estimates by 2-7% and raises FY26E-FY27E adjusted net profit estimates by 0-8%. 12m TP is US$134.

NetEase 3Q26 results were below expectations on slower game grossing and revenue growth. GS cuts its 12m TPs to US$160/HK$251 from US$168/HK$263 and treats the slowdown as product cycle timing. Margins held on cost discipline.

GS expects NetEase game revenue to fall 4% YoY in 4Q26 and cuts FY26E-FY28E revenue estimates by 3-5% and net profit estimates by 3-6%. Growth is expected to turn up in early 2027 on the global launch of Ananta. GS keeps the defensive, steady-FCF framing.

Asics management meeting: 1H orders were up 14% YoY in Europe and 18% YoY in the US as of end-October. Underlying P.Run sales grew 16% YoY in 3Q excluding timing shifts and reclassifications, and low-margin products are still 30% of North American volume. GS sees upside to the FY29 ¥1.5tn sales target. 12m TP is ¥6,000.

Ryohin Keikaku CEO meeting: management is more confident in its medium-term plan and overseas expansion in the US and Europe. China is strong on store renovations. The domestic e-commerce suspension is expected to have limited FY27 earnings impact, with a safe resumption targeted in 1H. 12m TP is ¥4,900.

GS reaffirms its bullish view on shipbuilding and positive stance on tankers after yard and shipping company visits. Managements expect the upcycle to run through at least 2032 on aging fleets, environmental rules and geopolitical disruption. Yard orderbooks cover delivery slots into 2029 or 2030, and expansion is limited by government approvals and a shortage of marine engines.

Tanker freight rates are supported by crude restocking and lower effective capacity from vessel rerouting. GS is conservative on container shipping because of potential oversupply and downward pressure on freight rates. Preferred names are Guangdong Songfa Ceramics (Hengli Heavy Industry), Yangzijiang Shipbuilding, COSCO Shipping Energy and COSCO Shipping Ports.

Eastroc management reiterates that energy drinks should return to positive growth in 2027 through channel diversification, regional penetration and new SKUs. Value retailers and catering are the two new channel pillars. Elevated PET costs are a near-term headwind that may be offset by lower promotion. Dividend payout stays at no less than 80% for FY25-FY27. 12m TP is Rmb130.7.

Japan Healthcare catalysts: Takeda's Capital Markets Day and Terumo's medium-term plan briefing in December, PeptiDream's December R&D Day, Phase 3 data for Otsuka HD's ulotaront and Ono's PoC trial for ONO-2020 before end-2026, and Daiichi Sankyo's AVANZAR data in early 2027.

Kyocera will sell about ¥116bn of KDDI shares, cutting its stake to 12.77% from 13.74%, via a reported block trade. Unlike the June 2025 and June 2026 sales, KDDI will not respond with a buyback. GS is Neutral with a ¥2,920 TP and says stable ARPU-driven earnings growth is already priced in.

a2 Milk fell 11% after FY27 guidance was maintained, which GS calls an overreaction. Guidance implies a modest revenue downgrade excluding FX, driven by English label softness, recall impacts, reformulation transitions and Genesis importation constraints. Pokeno is now expected to be marginally EBITDA positive in FY27. 12m TPs are A$8.1/NZ$10.

Japan Post Bank disclosed for the first time an upward path for ROE and net profit from FY29, and a sensitivity of +¥100bn per +25bps of BOJ rate hikes. The FY28 targets of 10% ROE and ¥1tn net profit are described as a passing point. GS is Buy with a ¥3,900 TP.

Lenovo 2Q revenue of US$30bn was 8% above GSe and 10% above Bloomberg consensus, and adjusted net income of US$1.4bn beat GSe by 5% and consensus by 12%. Infrastructure Solutions Group revenue rose 178% YoY with OPM at 9.6%, and AI server revenue rose over 300% YoY. 12m TP is HK$51.

China appliance tracker for October: export volume rose 14% and value 21% YoY while domestic retail grew 2.5% YoY on an easier base. Singles' Day appliance sales were flat to low single-digit growth, and domestic air conditioner ex-factory shipments fell 25% YoY. GS highlights Midea, Roborock and Anker.

GS Cross Asset 2027 Outlook is modestly pro-risk with more balance as nominal and earnings growth approach a peak in 2027. It is overweight equities, bonds, the US and Japan, neutral Asia and EM, and underweight Europe and credit. GS forecasts the end-2027 10-year US Treasury yield at 4.6% and lowers its end-2027 gold forecast to $4,650/toz.

market_movers.rationale: 12m TPs cut from US$177/HK$172 after cloud growth guidance was lowered. GS sees FCF turning positive by 2H28 and EPS inflection in FY27E and FY28E.
Ad revenue re-accelerated and adjusted operating profit beat by 51%. Transaction services revenue fell 12% YoY on Temu's EU customs changes.
12m TPs cut from US$168/HK$263 on slower game grossing. GS expects growth to turn up in early 2027 with the Ananta launch.
Asics: 1H orders up 14% YoY in Europe and 18% in the US. GS sees room for profitability improvement and upside to the FY29 ¥1.5tn sales target.
Ryohin Keikaku: management is more confident in overseas growth, and GS sees substantial room for operational improvement.
Guangdong Songfa Ceramics (Hengli Heavy Industry) is a preferred shipbuilder. Yard capacity is tight and orderbooks cover slots into 2029 or 2030.
Yangzijiang Shipbuilding is a preferred shipbuilder on the sustained shipbuilding upcycle.
COSCO Shipping Energy is the preferred tanker operator. Freight rates are supported by crude restocking and lower effective capacity.
COSCO Shipping Ports is the preferred port operator in GS's shipping and shipbuilding trip takeaways. The disclosures list it as Buy at HK$6.82, which is a share price and not a target.
Eastroc: energy drinks targeted to resume growth in 2027 and dividend payout of at least 80% for FY25-FY27.
GS is watching Takeda's December Capital Markets Day for changes to longer-term earnings expectations, and the launch of Orzeyful.
KDDI: Kyocera is selling about ¥116bn of shares with no buyback response. Stable earnings growth is already priced in, and GS is cautious on further shareholder stake reductions.
a2 Milk: GS calls the 11% share drop an overreaction. FY27E-29E EPS sit at -2%, -1% and +2% versus prior consensus.
Japan Post Bank: new disclosures show an upward ROE and profit path from FY29 and a rate-hike sensitivity of +¥100bn per +25bps.
Lenovo: 2Q beat on AI server demand, with ISG revenue up 178% YoY and OPM at 9.6%.
Midea, Roborock and Anker are highlighted for overseas growth potential and market share gains in China consumer durables.

sector_views.rationale: Upcycle expected through at least 2032 on aging fleets, environmental regulation and geopolitical disruption, with tight yard capacity.
Freight rates are supported by crude restocking demand and lower effective capacity from vessel rerouting.
GS is conservative on potential oversupply and downward pressure on freight rates.
Exports are resilient while domestic retail demand is muted, with early signs of pricing improvement.
Above-trend earnings support the overweight, though a plateauing AI capex impulse is likely to slow earnings growth in 2027.
Tight spreads, releveraging and rising supply.
Neutral rating, with continued diversification benefits.

earnings_insights: Alibaba 2QFY27 reported adjusted group EBITA was 6% above GSe. Traditional domestic e-commerce profits were stable and quick commerce losses narrowed.

PDD 3Q26 reported adjusted operating profit was Rmb32.6bn, 51% above GSe. Online marketing services revenue grew 12% YoY against GS's 10% estimate, and transaction services revenue fell 12% YoY against GS's +6% estimate.
NetEase 3Q26 reported results were below expectations on slower game grossing and revenue growth. GS forecasts 4Q26E game revenue down 4% YoY.
Lenovo 2Q reported revenue was US$30bn, 8% above GSe and 10% above Bloomberg consensus. Reported adjusted net income was US$1.4bn, up 27% QoQ, 5% above GSe and 12% above Bloomberg consensus.
Lenovo segment results: IDG revenue grew 15% YoY to US$17bn with OPM at 7.1%. ISG revenue grew 178% YoY to US$11bn with OPM at 9.6%. SSG operating margin reached 26%.
a2 Milk FY27 guidance was reiterated, which GS reads as a modest revenue downgrade excluding the FX tailwind. Pokeno is now expected to be marginally EBITDA positive in FY27.
Japan Post Bank 1H26 results review: management targets 10% ROE and ¥1tn net profit by FY28 and gave a path above those levels from FY29.
Asics underlying P.Run sales growth in 3Q was 16% YoY excluding sales timing shifts and category reclassifications, and total P.Run average selling prices rose 4% YoY.

macro_indicators.interpretation: Exports are resilient on market share gains and better consumer sentiment in major overseas markets.
Value is growing faster than volume, consistent with the early signs of pricing improvement GS notes.
Mildly improving growth on an easier base, with domestic demand still described as muted.
Near trend growth, with a plateauing AI capex impulse expected to slow earnings growth.
GS forecast, consistent with its overweight bonds stance.
GS lowered its gold forecast to this level.

risk_factors: Alibaba: overseas compute constraints, soft macro consumption and peak AI infrastructure investment in CY27 and CY28 weighing on FCF.
PDD: Temu's exposure to EU customs changes and evolving global regulations on transaction services revenue.
NetEase: volatility in legacy game titles and the timing of new game launches.
Container shipping: potential oversupply and downward pressure on freight rates.
Eastroc: elevated PET costs are a near-term headwind.
a2 Milk: English label softness, recall impacts and constrained distribution while the China label channel is rebuilt.
Global markets: a plateauing AI capex impulse is likely to slow earnings growth in 2027, with tight credit spreads and rising supply.
vol_and_positioning: Kyocera is planning a block trade to sell about ¥116bn of KDDI shares, taking its stake to 12.77% from 13.74%.
GS is cautious on further capital allocation changes at KDDI as major shareholders, including Toyota, focus on reducing strategic stakes.
geopolitical: Overseas compute constraints cap Alibaba's CY27 Cloud revenue growth guidance.
EU customs changes are pushing Temu to move to local fulfillment, which cut PDD transaction services revenue.
Geopolitical disruptions and vessel rerouting support the shipbuilding upcycle and tanker freight rates.
